title: Scope redlines for Console Insights MVP and staged degraded-mode plan
creator: Leah Park
description: Purpose: capture the final scope reductions and acceptance criteria for the Console Insights MVP slice so engineering can ship a coherent, reliable surface that meets latency and cost targets. This ticket documents which visualizations and features are deferred, the fallback behavior (degraded-mode), deterministic acceptance criteria, and the rollout/rollback plan. Background: recent capacity constraints and telemetry cost projections require trimming nonessential cards and prioritizing observability of customer-facing routes and cost attribution for top spenders. This write-up consolidates the PRD clarifications from the PM/Eng/design sync on 2025-01-28.
decisions: Cut: Historical per-route heatmaps (defer to post-MVP)
Cut: Inline distributed trace flamegraphs in card view — traces will link to full trace viewer instead
Keep: Top-level route latency P50/P95 card for top-10 routes by request volume
Keep: Cost breakdown summary card limited to top-5 models and top-5 routes
Defer: Per-token cost drilldown for now (will ship as console-2025.04 feature)
Add: degraded-mode UX that surfaces 'limited telemetry' and link to sampling settings when ingestion budget exceeded
acceptance_criteria: Latency card: P50 and P95 computed and displayed for top-10 routes; data age <= 60s in UI
Cost card: Aggregated cost per route and per-model for top-5 items; last 24h and last 7d selectable
Trace link behavior: each request card must include a stable link (URL) to the full trace viewer with trace id; clicking must open viewer with correct filter
Sampling and retention: Default trace sampling = 1/100; UI must show current sample rate and a short explanation tooltip
Degraded-mode: When ingest budget exceeded, console shows a banner with affected cards and a toggle to view 'cached/stale' data (last successful snapshot).
metrics_targets: E2E UI render for insights page <= 600ms on 95th percentile (internal chrome emulation)
Card backend query latency <= 350ms for top-10 routes under nominal load
Telemetry ingestion cost delta <= 8% vs projected baseline after sampling defaults
Acceptance test coverage: at least 6 automated end-to-end tests covering card rendering and degraded-mode banner
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): 10% of org internal users; validate performance and correctness; duration 72 hours
Phase 2 (beta): opt-in for customers with ties to observed routes and internal beta pool; duration 7 days
Phase 3 (general): full launch to all users assuming no critical regressions
Rollback: instant feature-flag disabling that returns console to pre-insights UI and routes traffic away from new telemetry collectors
qa_test_cases: Render top-10 route latency cards against synthetic load (verify P50/P95 values align with source metrics)
Simulate ingestion budget exceeded and verify degraded-mode banner appears and 'cached' view loads correctly
Click trace link from a card and assert the full trace viewer filters to the correct trace id and duration range
Verify cost card aggregates align with billing export for top-5 models (delta <= 2%)
Confirm sampling control tooltip copy is present and correct in all supported locales
notes: Trade-offs: removing heatmaps reduces exploratory capability for alpha customers but preserves core latency + cost signals for early GA
Follow-up: schedule post-MVP design session to reintroduce heatmap + per-token cost as opt-in features
PM ask of eng: add short-lived feature flag for traces-and-cards to enable instant rollback
Design ask: provide alternative small-screen layout to ensure top-5 cards remain visible without horizontal scrolling
updates: 2025-01-28: PM/Eng/Design sync — agreed to conservative cutset to safeguard telemetry budget
2025-01-31: Eng estimates updated; sampling defaults implemented in branch feature/insights-sample
2025-02-04: Design delivered compact card variants; small adjustments requested to tooltip copy
2025-02-05: Document finalized and scope redline approved by product leadership
